minimumUnblock: A geocoded primary or official record that binds the visible 518 premise and the Fahua Heritage structure to a specific side of the Fahuazhen/Xianghuaqiao intersection.
A wider continuous view or georeferenced plan showing a readable road control, both street edges, full structure, adjacent wall endpoints and the rear boundary.
At least two independently locatable world controls plus one defensible physical dimension or calibrated camera solution for scale and reprojection error.
A complete left, right and rear walkaround sequence with measured or authoritative curb, sidewalk and asphalt boundaries.
verdict: The two frames materially close side/depth and local street-context coverage, but they do not close 518 to saved OSM or supply scale, yaw, footprint, rear geometry or complete walkaround. Keep exact map, rear and scale blocked; retain all current files and accepted stages unchanged.
